start: Android phone, Settings > Rest timer and sounds, 'Workout sounds' on, 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' off

steps.action: Turn on 'Ring through Do Not Disturb'
user_sees: Caption 'Rest is over still rings while Do Not Disturb is on'
must_not: The switch shown on an iPhone

steps.action: Turn on Do Not Disturb, tick a set, lock the phone, wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings with the chosen sound at alarm volume
must_not: Silence while the switch is on
The sound only at media volume

steps.action: Turn the switch off and finish another rest with Do Not Disturb still on
user_sees: No bell from the open app
must_not: The alarm channel rings while the switch is off

start: Switch on, Do Not Disturb on, MettleUp open on screen

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end with the app on screen
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings once through Do Not Disturb

start: Switch off (the default), Do Not Disturb on

steps.action: Finish a rest with the phone locked
user_sees: The watch buzz follows the phone's choice
must_not: A sound through Do Not Disturb
The app's own bell plays when the app opens

start: A rest counting down, Do Not Disturb on, switch off

must_not: The watch keeps the old choice until the next rest

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: Phone rings through Do Not Disturb, the watch buzz gets through too
must_not: Only the next rest follows the change

start: Switch on, Do Not Disturb on, the phone on a shared table at night

user_sees: The alarm channel 'Rest is over, through Do Not Disturb' rings
Lock screen shows 'Rest is over' and the next set
must_not: The alarm channel used for anything other than 'Rest is over'
The DND channel used while the switch is off
